profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta | GenAI evaluation platforms
profile.summary:
I build platforms that help teams ship high-quality products at scale.

At Meta, I build systems that operate under high QPS/low latency constraints, and I build evaluation frameworks that use LLM-as-a-Judge to track product quality. I work on turning messy model behavior into actionable signals: clear verdict types, interpretable metrics, automated evaluation at scale, and the telemetry needed to trust results over time.

Previously at Microsoft. Research background in VR/HCI (at SFU), including IEEE TVCG.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Social AI ML Infra
positions.description:
Led the 0 to 1 design and rollout of an auto-judge evaluation framework for Social AI, becoming the default way feature owners measure product quality.
	• Scaled evaluation capacity about 30x by using LLM-as-a-judge to automate labeling, cutting typical evaluation cycles from 2 weeks to about 2 hours and unblocking faster iterations.
	• Built high quality auto-judges with around 80 percent precision and recall against expert human labels.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Ads Infrastructure
positions.description:
Drove revenue, reliability, and scale for FB's Ads Ranking Data Service (ARDS), one of the highest-QPS services in the ads stack.
	• Drove key pieces of the Ad Embedding Freshness initiative, tightening the feedback loop between engagement signals and embedding updates and helping deliver roughly 0.2% GAS.
	• Turned ARDS from a black box into a glass box by building unified metrics and end-to-end observability, cutting alert noise, speeding RCA, and making feature rollouts safer.
	• Prototyped a multi-tier architecture that demonstrated ~5x horizontal scale with negligible impact on p99 latency, giving the org a clear path to handle future query growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - M365 Copilot
positions.description: During the early rollout of Copilot for Business, we discovered a critical blind spot: product and sales leaders had no visibility into how many licensed seats were sitting unassigned at the tenant level. I framed this as a go-to-market risk and led the design and launch of an internal dashboard that surfaced license-utilization gaps by tenant and segment, enabling the field team to prioritize outreach where friction was highest and convert “dark” licenses into active usage ahead of GA.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Microsoft Search in Bing
positions.description:
Drove analytics insights for M365 org, turning raw telemetry into executive dashboards and tools for product and compliance leaders.
	• Designed and shipped an insights dashboard for Bing@Work, that consolidated hundreds of telemetry metrics into a single view of OKRs and product health, used by PMs and leadership for weekly and quarterly reviews.
	• Owned end to end ETL pipelines processing petabyte scale telemetry data per day, turning raw usage signals into self serve reporting, automated alerts, and predictive insights that helped product and business teams make faster decisions.
	• Built and productionized an LLM-based PII safeguarding tool, improving sensitive data detection accuracy by about 10% by reducing false-positives by about 90%, lowering manual review overhead and compliance risk.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research focus: making VR navigation and orientation more natural and practical in small spaces.
	•	Efficient VR locomotion in limited spaces (NaviBoard & NaviChair, IEEE TVCG): Designed and evaluated new VR locomotion interfaces that combine full physical rotation with limited translation, showing that leaning based motion on compact platforms can deliver navigation performance close to real walking without requiring large tracking spaces or expensive treadmills.  ￼
	•	Reducing disorientation with low cost visual cues (Simulated Reference Frame, IEEE VR): Demonstrated that adding a simple simulated reference frame (a subtle virtual box in the scene) significantly improves users spatial orientation, task completion time, and path efficiency in VR, offering a cost effective way for VR apps to keep people oriented even in visually sparse environments.
positions.insights: User Research, Virtual Reality (VR) and +1 skill
